kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From Aramaic צְלוֹבְחָא (ṣəlōḇḥā), צְלְבְחָא (ṣəlḇəḥā). Compare Hebrew צְלוֹפָח (ṣlōfá̄ḥ, “eel”) from its variant צְלוֹפְחָא (ṣəlōp̄ḥā). Some leeway must be given for the underlying Aramaic vocalism since the attested forms are Jewish Babylonian Aramaic, never per se the source of Arabic. In Classical Syriac only lexicographers transmit ܙܠܒܪܝܐ (zəlaḇrəyā), which is possibly corrupt and rather *ܙܠܒܚܐ (zəlāḇḥā).
